Class HorizonResponseModel

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.mpc.HorizonResponseModel
All Implemented Interfaces:

final class HorizonResponseModel extends Object implements Serializable
Sampled unit-step responses and applied-input history for a measurement-corrected prediction.

      HorizonResponseModel(List<ManipulatedVariable> mvs, List<DisturbanceVariable> dvs, List<ControlledVariable> cvs, double interval, StepResponse[] responses)

    • plan

      HorizonPlan plan(List<ManipulatedVariable> mvs, List<ControlledVariable> cvs, double[] inputs, double[][] preview, int prediction, int control, double interval)
      Optimize future inputs with past input changes and preview disturbances accounted for.
      Parameters:
      mvs - manipulated variables
      cvs - controlled variables with current measurements
      inputs - current absolute MV values followed by DV values
      preview - future absolute DV values with a held tail
      prediction - number of predicted samples
      control - number of independent moves
      interval - configured sample interval
      Returns:
      solver result
